# Read the file
with open('semver.py', 'r') as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

# Find key insertion points
createparser_line = None
process_line = None
main_line = None
bump_patch_line = None

for i, line in enumerate(lines):
    if line.startswith('def createparser():'):
        createparser_line = i
    elif line.startswith('def process(args):'):
        process_line = i
    elif line.startswith('def main(cliargs=None):'):
        main_line = i
    elif line.startswith('def bump_patch(version):'):
        bump_patch_line = i

print(f"createparser at line {createparser_line}")
print(f"process at line {process_line}")  
print(f"main at line {main_line}")
print(f"bump_patch at line {bump_patch_line}")
